scripts.dev:locale: npx concurrently -n "api,worker" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:redis: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dockerCmd = (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $docker = if ($dockerCmd) { $dockerCmd.Source } else { $candidates=@(\"${env:ProgramFiles}\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"C:\\Program Files\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\"); ($candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1) }; if (-not $docker) { Write-Host 'Docker is required for Redis but `docker` was not found (PATH not reloaded?). Close/reopen terminal (or reboot) then retry.'; exit 1 }; if (-not (Get-Command docker-credential-desktop -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Host 'Docker Desktop credential helper not found: docker-credential-desktop. Fix: restart Docker Desktop + reopen terminal, or ensure `C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin` is in PATH, or reinstall Docker Desktop.'; exit 1 }; $name=(& $docker ps --filter \"name=afi-listen-redis\" --format \"{{.Names}}\" 2>$null); if ($name -eq 'afi-listen-redis') { Write-Host 'Redis already running (afi-listen-redis)'; }; & $docker compose up redis"
scripts.dev:stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dockerCmd = (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $docker = if ($dockerCmd) { $dockerCmd.Source } else { $candidates=@(\"${env:ProgramFiles}\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"C:\\Program Files\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\",\"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Docker\\Docker\\resources\\bin\\docker.exe\"); ($candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1) }; if ($docker) { & $docker compose down } else { Write-Host 'Docker not found; nothing to stop.' }"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "redis,api,worker" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:redis" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.render:build: npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.render:start:api: npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/server.js
